newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala May coffee exports 406,026 60-kilo bags.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala May coffee exports 406,026 60-kilo bags.

text.p: Guatemala exported 406,026 60-kilo bags of coffee in May, the National Coffee Association (Anacafe) said on Monday.
Exports for the month were 11 percent lower than May 1996 exports of 457,632 60-kilo bags, Anacafe president Julio Arrivillaga told Reuters.
May exports were 29 percent lower than in April this year, when 574,634 60-kilo bags of coffee were exported.
The drop was not unexpected and is not unusual, due to high exports at the beginning of the year, Arrivillaga said.

Exports for the year so far total 3,784,111 60-kilo bags with the harvest completed and little coffee remaining for export, he said. That total falls within the coffee association's predictions for the year, he said.
The extent of damage to coffee plantations caused by last week's Tropical Storm Andres is still being assessed by investigators in the field, Arrivillaga said.
